findings.analysis: The coverage gap is real, but restoring the requested permanent test would reverse the frozen head's explicit simplification. Commit ddf49e87369c0aa2ba4e258df2575cd3330db874 added precisely this installed-agent deferred-send test; db5cda674e411e0adfe3bf60ec90888b996a19de deliberately removed it and its version-specific suite, documenting the constructor boundary instead. The production change retains the existing context advice and only expands its settings-type matcher. For this review, the historical regression was run from temporary files with the installed agent against verified 5.0.0/ProducerSettings and 5.0.2/PublishingSettings runtimes. Both passed, asserting that the producer span is parented to submission rather than later-ambient. Compilation, formatting, and all four existing unit tests also passed. Preserve the deliberate scope decision rather than reintroducing the same deleted suite; no concrete implementation defect was found. Temporary validation does not add permanent regression coverage.

metadata.body:
RocketMQ 5.0.0 uses `ProducerSettings` where 5.0.1+ clients use `PublishingSettings`. Match both constructor signatures so deferred sends retain the submission context instead of inheriting the ambient context when they execute.
